_comment: Copy-paste detector configuration for scripts/check-clones.mjs (#1731). Run by /reuse-check before every PR and by /pre-release-sweeps; never in CI, never a merge gate.

One entry per code boundary (.codesight/wiki/code-boundaries.md). Each boundary is scanned on its own, so a clone between frontend/ and mobile/ is never reported: those are parity twins, not duplication.
jscpd: the pinned detector version, run with `pnpm dlx`. paths and ignore are relative to the repo root; format is jscpd's format names.

Ignored everywhere: generated files, the locale catalogues, migrations, tests and their fixtures. Tests repeat setup on purpose; a clone in a test is not drift in shipped code. skipInlineTests (Rust) also drops a clone whose two copies both sit inside an inline `#[cfg(test)] mod`, which no path glob can reach.
The accepted clones live in scripts/clones-baseline.json. A clone not in it fails the check; `--update-baseline` rewrites it after a clone is removed (ratchet down) or deliberately accepted.
